legalName: Portfolio of Brantley Farm Solar, LLC; Buckleberry Solar, LLC; Fox Creek Farm Solar, LLC; Innovative Solar 54, LLC; and Innovative Solar 67, LLC
summary: Keep one five-project North Carolina Solar portfolio. Correct the initial investment year to 2018. John Laing was the original sponsor; a public FERC filing confirms KKR acquired John Laing on September 22, 2021 and Equitix completed a 50% JLIL purchase on October 6, 2021, leaving KKR and Equitix as 50:50 upstream owners with joint control of all five sellers. A direct April 2, 2026 John Laing release still describes JLIL as 50:50 owned by KKR-owned John Laing Group Limited and Equitix, and no later portfolio exit or pending transaction was found. Granite is a separate eight-project portfolio.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: The exact successor Equitix legal wrapper after Equitix Ether Bidco ceased PSC status on March 27, 2026 is not publicly disclosed.
The historic 9.9% project-level interests are not shown to be a separate infrastructure-manager owner and should not be inferred as one.
